lesson.title: 7.8 Please Repeat
lesson.unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson.lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.goal: Repair a misunderstanding, hear the information again and use it to reach a destination.
lesson.grammar_function: Identify a communication problem, request repetition or clearer speech, confirm unchanged information and reach the destination.
lesson.prerequisite: 5.9 please and thank you; 6.7 Excuse me. and Can you help me?; 4.1 bathroom; 4.3 Where is ...?
lesson.speaking_outcome: Repair a misunderstanding, hear the information again and use it to reach a destination.
